chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Muthannā, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAjlān, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning His, the Exalted, saying:
Surely the nearest of people to Ibrāhīm are those who followed him, and this Prophet, and those who believed.
He said: They are the Imams عليهم السلام and those who follow them.

key_terms.أَوْلَى: nearest and most entitled in closeness and affiliation
key_terms.اتَّبَعُوهُ: followed him in faith and path
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams عليهم السلام as the divinely guided leaders
key_terms.بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: to Ibrāhīm عليه السلام, in spiritual relation and following
key_terms.هَذَا النَّبِيُّ: this Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَهُمْ: and whoever follows them in loyalty and obedience

ai.seo_question: Who are the people nearest to Ibrāhīm according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام in Quran 3:68?
ai.summary: This narration explains the Quranic verse by identifying those nearest to Ibrāhīm عليه السلام as the Imams عليهم السلام and those who follow them. It emphasizes wilayah and true spiritual succession through faith and following the divinely guided leaders.
